title: A News tile for Home: does it earn one, and what does it show?
question: Each sketch is dev's real Home (the sermon, bulletin, prayer and the rest) with the News tile placed under the latest sermon, in brand light, brand dark on a day a post is urgent, and the 2026 theme, plus every other size on the right. Dev has no news posts yet, so the posts are samples. My recommendation: A, the front page in miniature. It's the only one that gives Home something it doesn't already have: a fresh picture from church life each week. B repeats the Notifications tile and C repeats This week's look. If none of them earns its place, D (no tile) is an honest choice too. Whichever you pick, a post marked urgent today takes the tile over, as it does at the top of the News page. Worth knowing: the app's News icon is almost the same drawing as the bulletin's.

options.label: A: A front page in miniature
options.thesis: The newest post leads with its picture and headline; at 2 × 2 the one before it sits under a line. Tapping opens that post. The picture sits beside the headline when the tile is one row tall, and behind it in a single cell. A post urgent today takes a marker band across the top.
materials: a second headline under a hairline
options.viewport: Under the latest sermon, a 2 × 2 card: the Christmas post's picture, its headline and 'Church office · 2 hours ago', then 'Holiday program volunteers needed · Yesterday'.
options.risk: It leans on pictures: a week of posts without one falls back to words on the card, and two big picture cards (the sermon and News) stacked together could feel heavy.

options.label: B: Quiet until it matters
options.thesis: A small, sand-coloured tile: how many posts are new since you last opened News, and the newest headline. On a day a post is urgent it turns marker-orange and shows that post.
options.viewport: Under the sermon, a 2 × 1 row: '• 2 new in News' over the newest headline, with the News icon at the end.
options.risk: It does what the Notifications tile already does (a count and the newest), and 'new since you last looked' is a new thing for the phone to remember.

options.label: C: Headlines
options.thesis: A short list of the newest three headlines with when each was posted and 'All news' beside the title, drawn like This week's agenda; an urgent post goes first with Today.
options.viewport: Under the sermon, a full-width card 'News · All news ›' with three rows: 2h, Yesterday, Monday.
options.risk: It looks like This week, so Home gets two lists that are hard to tell apart, and long headlines are cut short at one-cell widths.

options.label: D: It doesn't earn a tile
options.thesis: Home stays as it is. News is a tab one tap away, a post that sends a notification already shows on the Notifications tile, and staff who want a door to News can add a plain tile that opens it.
options.viewport: Dev's Home unchanged; on the right, the Notifications tile with a church news post and a plain 'Church news' tile.
options.risk: Home never shows a picture from church life, and a post sent without a notification doesn't appear on Home at all.
